Classic Banana Bread

Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Mash three ripe bananas in a large bowl. Stir in 1/3 cup melted butter, 3/4 cup sugar, one egg, and a teaspoon of vanilla. Mix in 1 teaspoon baking soda and 1 1/2 cups flour. Pour into a loaf pan and bake for 60 minutes. Let cool before slicing.
